## [1.28.0] - 2026-07-25

Factory-hardening & customer-hosted foundations. Supervisor run-fatal fixes: backlog-item dispatch (#568), needs-human plan blockers (#570), and stale-blocked-item hold with live-frontier re-observation (#581). Pre-merge integrity: stale-archive-base fix, never force-push over reviewed code (#579). Install/salvage papercuts: logs-follower lock (#567), fix-harness salvage extension (#547) + worktree-locality root-cause (#553), Pi adapter npm doc (#571). Design foundations: orchestration/execution boundary for customer-hosted runners (#505), multi-repo fleet telemetry aggregation (#503), and privacy-safe upstream fault reporting (#502).

## [1.27.0] - 2026-07-24

Trace-Driven Eval Engineering: human-approved trace-to-fixture authoring with explicit environment fidelity (#535) and bounded treatment/verifier trajectory artifacts for eval diagnosis (#536). First milestone delivered end-to-end on the in-repo pipeline:loop supervisor absorbed in v1.26.0.

## [1.26.0] - 2026-07-24

Integrated Durable Orchestration: agent-pipeline now owns the durable multi-item loop end-to-end — typed blocker classification and recovery policies (#509), durable pause/wait states with audited scoped authority amendments (#510), live GitHub/git/checks truth reconciliation (#511), the in-repo pipeline:loop supervisor with resume and audit (#512), external dependency preservation and deadlock reporting (#513), durable-run blocker auto-filing via improve clustering (#538), documented native /goal bootstrap (#514), an integrated two-item live pilot with recovery (#515), and conflict-aware parallel execution: ownership surfaces and conflict relationships (#529), a deterministic independent-set scheduler (#530), parallel-execution verification (#531), and the epic integration with a durable parallelization decision ledger (#528).

## [1.25.0] - 2026-07-23

Correction intelligence: structured correction_event ledger for operator interventions (#499), correction compiler clustering repeated corrections into reusable-control proposals (#500), closed-loop control attribution + repeat-correction scoreboard (#501), salvage staging correctness for nested node_modules and pipeline-internal markers (#521, #522), exhaustive drift-proof init config (#504), intake ROADMAP-anchor fix for API-created milestones (#539).
